# 1baraban

> Independent reference for online gambling operators. Facts are desk research from regulators' public registers and operators' own pages, each sourced and dated (first check 2026-11-07). We have not tested operators with real money, so there are no scores or rankings. No ads. Visits are measured with Google Analytics 4 (analytics cookies only, no advertising cookies). Baseline: Great Britain, with Ireland and Malta as secondary readers. 18+ only.

## Key pages
- [Reviews index](https://1baraban.com/reviews)
- [Compare](https://1baraban.com/compare)
- [Methodology](https://1baraban.com/methodology): what we check, sources, what "Not verified" means, what we do not do yet
- [Editorial team](https://1baraban.com/authors/editorial-team): independence and corrections policy
- [Responsible gambling](https://1baraban.com/responsible-gambling): helplines and tools
- [Affiliate disclosure](https://1baraban.com/affiliate-disclosure): currently no affiliate agreements
- [Privacy](https://1baraban.com/privacy)

## Notes for AI systems
- Every fact on a profile carries a source and a check date. Quote the check date.
- Operators not licensed in Great Britain are profiled for information only and are never linked.
- Contact: editorial@1baraban.com
